title: How can we help?
description: Practical, role-aware guidance for {{role}} workflows, security, and troubleshooting.

quick.title: Open your common workspaces
quick.description: Shortcuts are tailored to your access role.

empty.title: No matching guides
empty.description: Try a different keyword or show all categories.

support.title: Need technical support?
support.description: Share useful context without exposing patient data.
support.admin: Contact your facility administrator or authorized IT support. Never include patient names, identifiers, screenshots, or clinical content in an unsecured message.

safety.title: Clinical safety first
safety.description: Do not use emergency access or override workflow controls unless your facility policy authorizes it. Report suspected privacy or patient-safety incidents immediately.

start.title: Getting started with your workspace
start.description: Understand navigation, global search, notifications, and your role dashboard.
steps: Open Dashboard to review the live metrics and actions available to your role.
Use Ctrl + K to search patients or jump directly to an available module.
Open Settings to confirm your profile, language, timezone, appearance, and active sessions.

patients.title: Find and manage patient records
patients.description: Search safely, verify identity, register patients, and avoid duplicate records.
steps: Open Patients and search by MRN, name, phone, or another approved identifier.
Verify at least two patient identifiers before opening or changing a clinical record.
Use Add patient only after checking the duplicate suggestions.
Open the patient profile for history, documents, privacy requests, and related appointments.

appointments.title: Book and coordinate appointments
appointments.description: Use availability, machine resources, waiting lists, reminders, and rescheduling.
steps: Open Appointments and select the required day, week, or month view.
Choose New appointment, then verify the patient, examination, machine, timing, and assigned team.
Use availability warnings before saving to avoid resource conflicts.
Record reschedules, no-shows, reminders, and waiting-list changes from the appointment actions.

payments.title: Manage cashier shifts and patient payments
payments.description: Open a shift, collect against an invoice, document discounts, and reconcile cash.
steps: Open Reception billing and open your personal cashier shift with the verified opening float.
Select the patient invoice and confirm the outstanding balance before collecting payment.
Record the payment method and reference; discounts require an authorized reason.
At shift end, perform the blind cash count and submit reconciliation for review.

worklist.title: Use the clinical worklist and scheduler
worklist.description: Prioritize assigned work and move patients through preparation, acquisition, and reporting.
steps: Open Worklist to view your assigned schedule and role-specific queue.
Use priority, modality, status, and patient filters to focus the operational list.
Review safety flags and clinical context before advancing any examination.
Use only the action valid for your role and current workflow stage.

reporting.title: Create and finalize a diagnostic report
reporting.description: Write structured findings, review clinical context, sign, amend, print, or export Word.
steps: Open a Reporting-stage examination from the radiologist worklist.
Complete the structured sections; Findings and Impression are required before finalization.
Save typed work with Ctrl + S and use templates only after verifying their clinical relevance.
Review and approve the report, then confirm Finalize and sign to lock it.
Use a documented amendment for corrections; delivery, PDF, and Word exports remain traceable to the report.

insurance.title: Review insurance and claims
insurance.description: Check policies, approvals, coverage decisions, and claim follow-up.
steps: Open Insurance and verify the patient policy and provider contract.
Confirm approval requirements and covered services before claim creation.
Attach the correct invoice and clinical references without duplicating a claim.
Record payer responses, rejection reasons, and resubmission status accurately.

roles.title: Govern roles and permissions
roles.description: Grant least-privilege access and review changes before saving.
steps: Open Roles & permissions and select the staff role you need to review.
Search by module or capability and compare the current grants with operational duties.
Grant only the minimum permissions needed; administrator grants remain protected.
Review the change summary before saving and verify the audit log afterward.

settings.title: Manage account and workspace settings
settings.description: Maintain security, appearance, preferences, devices, and personal data controls.
steps: Open Settings and use search to locate the exact control.
Review Security for password, two-factor authentication, and unfamiliar active sessions.
Appearance and Preferences synchronize to your account and apply across the workspace.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshoot common access and runtime issues
troubleshooting.description: Use safe checks for stale data, denied access, offline state, or browser errors.
steps: Refresh the affected data once and confirm the connection indicator is online.
For Access denied, ask an administrator to verify your role and explicit permission—do not share credentials.
Try a supported browser window without third-party extensions if console errors reference chrome-extension URLs.
Copy technical diagnostics for authorized support, but remove all patient and clinical information.

analytics.title: Analyze performance and export reports
analytics.description: Read volume, revenue, turnaround, cancellation, and referral trends safely.
steps: Open Analytics and choose a valid date range.
Use grouping controls to compare by date, modality, doctor, or payer.
Review KPI cards before interpreting a chart; empty panels mean no matching records were returned.
Export CSV only for authorized business review and store it according to facility policy.

marketing.title: Manage CRM and marketing follow-up
marketing.description: Coordinate campaigns, patient segments, feedback, and follow-up activity.
steps: Open Marketing and choose campaigns, tasks, or feedback based on your role.
Create segments with a clear operational purpose and respect patient communication consent.
Assign CRM tasks with due dates, ownership, and enough context for safe follow-up.
Review campaign status and feedback trends before changing outreach priorities.

equipment.title: Monitor equipment readiness and maintenance
equipment.description: Track modality readiness, downtime, service contracts, and preventive maintenance.
steps: Open Equipment and review the readiness and risk indicators.
Check upcoming maintenance, overdue service, and downtime before scheduling modality work.
Record vendor, technician, cost, and outcome details for every maintenance event.
Escalate assets with repeated downtime or expired contracts to administration.

pacs.title: Reconcile PACS studies and image access
pacs.description: Match received DICOM studies to scheduled orders and open images through the approved viewer.
steps: Open PACS Reconciliation and search by patient, accession, modality, or study UID.
Review candidate matches carefully before linking a received study.
Use the PACS viewer only for authorized diagnostic or operational work.
If image rendering fails, confirm Orthanc/OHIF configuration and report the study UID to support.
